text: This staff report recommends an eastbound through prohibition (with a bicycle exemption) from 7:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m. and from 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday eastbound from Farm Greenway across Victoria Park Avenue to Terraview Boulevard. Currently, this through movement is allowed at all times. This matter is being tabled at the Public Works and Infrastructure Committee as it impacts both the North York Community Council and the Scarborough Community Council areas.

City Council on April 24, 25, 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council prohibit eastbound through movements from 7:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m., and from 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, from Farm Greenway to Terraview Boulevard at Victoria Park Avenue, bicycles excepted.
